scope: Corrected future Ready sample contract, planning-only review after historical controlled-fixture delivery. Not a replacement for completed production criteria, not a new acceptance or provider action. Family, style adoption and graphical renderer acceptance remain separate.

contract.intent: One static 16x16 Ready candidate for later assets/ready-confirmed.png. Required asymmetrical-arm check mark conveys success. Transparent background, full alpha permitted, no fixed palette. Cool blue accent relationship; Ready as representative sample is a specialist proposal, not approved style.

criteria.check: Decoded image is exactly 16x16 pixels with a single static frame (no horizontal strip, no extra canvas).
criteria.basis: Owner brief: 16x16 logical status cells and Ready is static. Consumer: succeeded maps to frames 1 and display.cell is [16,16].

criteria.check: The image has a transparent background rather than an unintended opaque canvas matte. Inspect subject construction and compositing at 1x and 3x nearest on #172336: intentional foreground backing, a plate or badge, and authored partial-alpha subject edges are permitted while the check mark remains readable and the background transparent.
criteria.basis: BRIEF.md line 3 requires a transparent background, not a glyph-only construction, binary alpha or a prohibition on intentional foreground backing. Distinguishing subject from matte needs visual judgment; alpha measurements are supporting diagnostics.

criteria.check: Ready visibly uses a check mark with asymmetrical arms to convey successful completion, readable at the specified display conditions. Judge the actual silhouette; no particular arm-length ratio, equal-length ban, stroke thickness or backing construction is required.
criteria.basis: BRIEF.md line 9 requires the qualitative asymmetric check and completion meaning. Asymmetry may arise from angle, position, thickness, curvature or length. A short-left/long-right construction is an expert option, not the exclusive rule.
criteria.scope: This Ready candidate. Collective distinctions with future Working, Retry and Paused candidates remain separately scheduled.

criteria.check: Composited on #172336, the silhouette is readable at 1x and at 3x nearest-neighbor scale, with no essential detail lost into the panel colour.
criteria.basis: Owner brief requires readable silhouettes inspected at 1x and 3x nearest on the actual dark panel; #172336 is the consumer-observed panel colour (display.background).
criteria.scope: This Ready candidate at the declared display conditions.

criteria.check: The image visibly uses the existing UI cool blue accent in a perceptible, coherent role. Compare with the observed #70b9ed Start fill; no dominant-blue coverage, exact-hex equality or palette-count restriction is imposed.
criteria.basis: BRIEF.md line 3 requires use of the cool blue accent and no fixed palette; extent and dominance remain design choices. Start fill is an observation, not an approved pixel-art reference.
criteria.scope: This Ready candidate compared with the existing Start vector.

sources.locator: lines 1-1: preserved vector fill and shape

criteria.check: For this proposed representative sample, judge deliberate pixel clusters and edge rhythm at 1x and 3x: avoid accidental stray noise or resampling blur that undermines the intended pixel-art reading. Intentional authored edge shading, partial alpha and decorative detail are permitted. Assess plausible family extension without claiming approval or requiring unproduced members.
criteria.basis: Scoped specialist expert review choice under the coherent pixel-art and representative-sample direction in BRIEF.md lines 3 and 5. This is not a universal ban on antialiasing, isolated intentional details or any fixed construction.
criteria.scope: This Ready sample, assessed for style review; passing does not approve the family style.
